reader_summary.overview: is a partner at Floodgate, a pre-seed and seed-stage venture capital firm he co-founded in 2006 with Anne Miuro-Ko. He has been on the Forbes Midas list eight times in the last decade and backed Twitter, Lyft, Twitch, Okta. Attempting to understand if he had been lucky or skillful, Mike studied venture winners and created a framework to describe startup capitalism.
